prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Convert the THREE approved dolphins in the supplied proposal image into a production transparent sprite atlas. Preserve the exact approved individual designs, gradient colors, anatomy, outlines, cheerful face, cream belly, pink cheeks, style and poses; no redesign. Stage1 is round baby pale sky blue, stage2 upward-curving aqua dolphin, stage3 curling dorsal fin and long flowing wave-shaped flippers / fan tail with blue-to-turquoise-to-pearl gradients. Do not shorten stage3 flowing fins or change body silhouette. ONE landscape canvas, 1536x1024, exactly THREE EQUAL COLUMNS and TWO EQUAL ROWS. Every character is centered within its own 512x512 cell, fully inside with at least 35 pixels clear transparent padding at every cell edge. Top row left-to-right stage1, stage2, stage3 with open eyes. Bottom row EXACT SAME corresponding body, same positioning, same size and outline and colors, only eyes become happy closed crescent eyes and smiling mouth. The bottom-row body geometry must match top row, no different limb pose. All six are full body, each roughly 400 pixels tall or wide, largest dimension around410px. Scale each stage to fit comfortably; will be sized in app later. No stage character crosses a cell boundary. Real transparent alpha background, no shadows on floor, no labels, no titles, no arrows, no frames, no floating decorative sparkles, no extra objects, no hats. Keep high-quality painterly 2.5D gradient rendering with clean alpha edges and transparent gaps between limbs. This is an extraction/adaptation of the approved designs into game assets, not a fresh interpretation.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a transparent production sprite atlas using ONLY the THREE TURTLES from TOP ROW of the supplied approved design. Exclude crabs. Preserve each turtle exactly: the big cute dark eyes and mint face, cream belly, anatomy, pose, shell shape and APPROVED BROAD GRADIENT COLORS. Stage1 compact round baby, tiny oval flippers, PALE MINT mostly monochrome shell. Stage2 longer turtle, medium front flippers and oval shell with pale-mint to turquoise gradient. Stage3 broad subtly scalloped shield-shaped shell with strong pale mint ridge to deep sea-teal edge gradient, very long gracefully sweeping SINGLE-SURFACE front flippers, two short rear flippers. Match reference exactly, NOT a flower shell. Do not add leaves, islands, pools, vegetation, ornaments or magical objects. All turtles have exactly FOUR FLIPPERS, with perspective occlusion allowed, NEVER five; preserve front-flipper placement from reference, the far long foreflipper rises diagonally behind shell. ONE landscape 1536x1024 transparent canvas, exactly THREE EQUAL COLUMNS x TWO EQUAL ROWS, 512x512 cells. Top row left-to-right stage1, stage2, stage3 open-eyed friendly smile. Bottom row duplicate exact same stages, sizes, outlines, poses and palette, change ONLY facial expression to happy closed crescent eyes and delighted smile. Faces stay in identical position in both rows. Every full-body turtle wholly within its cell with >=35px transparent margin all around, maximum dimension about410px, centered in cell. No overlap or cropped flippers. True transparent alpha background, no cast floor shadows, no text, no captions, no arrows, no frames, no sparkles, no hats, no other creatures. High-quality soft painterly 2.5D finish, coherent clean smooth whole-shell gradients following shell curvature, clear scute divisions. No random mottled colors on shell. The lower expression row must not change geometry or body proportions. Faithful asset extraction, not a design reinterpretation.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a faithful transparent production sprite atlas of ONLY THREE HERMIT CRABS from BOTTOM ROW of the supplied approved design. No turtles. Preserve each approved exact character design, shell outline, body proportions, legs, claws, pose, two short eyestalks, peach body, cream pincer tips and GRADIENT SHELL COLORS. Stage1 round peach baby with small equal mitten pincers, compact round low-spired shell PALE PEACH/CREAM, nearly monochrome. Stage2 distinct longer diagonal conical shell with two spiral turns, peach apex flowing into pink/lavender by opening, clearer walking legs, one slightly larger claw. Stage3 broad LOW-spired shell with softly flared cream aperture rim and three gentle shoulder nodules, smooth blush-peach at upper left through rose pink into lavender/periwinkle lower edge, mother-of-pearl highlights, one dramatically large rounded notched pincer raised beside face and one smaller claw. Exact same shell shape and asymmetry as reference. Do not add taller tiers or fancy props. Important: ALL have TWO SHORT EYESTALKS with eyes at their tips, not eyes flat on face. ONE landscape1536x1024 canvas, THREE EQUAL COLUMNS x TWO EQUAL ROWS of512x512 cells. Top row left-to-right approved stages1,2,3 with large dark open eyes and happy smile. Bottom row exact same body geometry, pose, size and shell, ONLY eyes become upward happy closed crescent curves at the tips of the same two short eyestalks and mouth a delighted smile. Eye stalk shapes and locations retained. No extra pair of eyes on face. Both rows must align correspondingly. Center each full-body crab wholly inside its cell with >=35px padding all around; maximum dimension about410px. True transparent alpha background, no ground shadow, no labels, arrows, titles, frames, hats, glow aura, separate gems, treasure, ships, lanterns or other objects. Pastel smooth whole-shell gradient replaces mottled spots and zebra bands, preserve spiral via shading not repeated stripes. High quality soft painterly2.5D, clean translucent edge pixels and transparent spaces between limbs. No anatomy reinterpretation, this is the approved character converted to production assets with one smile-expression variant.
